# RecruitersLineUp

> > The largest free directory of recruiting firms, headhunters, and executive search specialists across 700+ US cities and all major industries.

RecruitersLineUp is a comprehensive recruiter directory platform that helps job seekers, companies, and HR professionals find qualified staffing firms and headhunters by location and industry specialization. With 10,000+ recruiting firms indexed across all 50 US states and major metropolitan areas, it serves as a centralized resource for talent acquisition and executive search services.

## Key Topics

- recruiter directory
- headhunters
- executive search
- staffing firms
- talent acquisition

- metropolitan recruiting
- talent placement

## Core Directory & Navigation

- [RecruitersLineUp Homepage](https://www.recruiterslineup.com): Main directory with 10,000+ recruiting firms, headhunters, and executive search firms
- [About RecruitersLineUp](https://www.recruiterslineup.com/about): Platform overview: 10,000 recruiting firms across 700 cities nationwide

## Geographic Search & State Directories

- [Browse Recruiters by State](https://recruiterslineup.com/recruiters/states): Browse recruiters by state across all 50 US states
- [Texas Recruiters Directory](https://www.recruiterslineup.com/recruiters/states/texas): Texas recruiters, headhunters, and search firms by location
- [Michigan Recruiters Directory](https://www.recruiterslineup.com/recruiters/states/michigan): Michigan recruiters, headhunters, and search firms by location
- [Maryland Recruiters Directory](https://www.recruiterslineup.com/recruiters/states/maryland): Maryland recruiters, headhunters, and search firms by location

## Industry-Specific Recruiting

- [Fashion & Textile Recruiters](https://www.recruiterslineup.com/industries/fashion-textile): Fashion and textile industry recruiters directory by location
- [Aerospace Recruiters](https://www.recruiterslineup.com/industries/aerospace): Aerospace industry recruiters, headhunters, and search firms
- [B2B Sales Recruiting Specialists](https://www.recruiterslineup.com/b2b-sales-recruiting-specialists-list): B2B sales recruiting specialists directory and search
